Subject: Post-call: Proposed global sync blocks for technical deep-dive

Hi Kate / John —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical deep-dive: 

Recap (2 min):
- Primary goal: validate latency and security requirements for your multi-region inference pipelines and confirm SLI targets.
- Key constraints: APAC teams prefer mornings, EU team constrained between 10:00–16:00 CET, US engineering prefers 09:00–13:00 PT.
- Must-include folks for the deep-dive: Acme infra lead (your side), Redwood infra eng, and a security contact for a short SOC/data flow walkthrough.

Next step: technical deep-dive (90 minutes) — scheduling ask
- Instead of a single permanent meeting time, we recommend a 3-week rolling sync pattern so the core set of stakeholders across US/EU/APAC can attend on a rotating basis without drastically shifting local hours week-to-week.
- Proposed "global sync blocks" (pick one pattern):
  Option A (fixed 3-week rotation):
    • Week 1 (APAC-friendly): 07:00–08:30 PT / 10:00–11:30 ET / 19:00–20:30 SGT
    • Week 2 (EU-friendly): 08:30–10:00 PT / 11:30–13:00 ET / 16:30–18:00 CEST
    • Week 3 (US-friendly): 09:00–10:30 PT / 12:00–13:30 ET / 20:00–21:30 SGT
  Option B (compressed windows): three 60-min blocks staggered Monday/Wednesday/Friday so each region gets one mid-week slot every three weeks.

Can you confirm which option you'd prefer and the core attendees you want invited on each rotation? I attached the short discovery notes and a .ics that contains Option A as a sample recurring series.

If Calendly is easier for your team, I saw Kate's link in the chat and we can publish the recurring pattern there — happy to let Laura own the final invite once we agree.

Attachments: discovery-notes-ACME.pdf (summary), proposed-global-sync-blocks.ics (example series)

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
